<Diagram name="system" alt="Hashi's system map: swap screen, route engine and swap runner in the browser; the money path from your EVM or Solana wallet through NEAR Intents or THORChain to your Bitcoin Cash wallet, then Cauldron for PUSD or MUSD; Reown AppKit, the Hashi relayer, WizardConnect and Electrum servers beneath" caption="Hashi in your browser, your dollars' path, and the services each step uses." />

## The parts

| Part | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Swap screen | browser | the card, picker, routes, review, settings |
| Route engine | browser | asks NEAR Intents, THORChain and Cauldron for prices, adds the fees they leave out, ranks by what you keep |
| Swap runner | browser | runs a swap one step at a time; each step saved in IndexedDB before the next (selling PUSD or MUSD through THORChain, the sale is saved before the send) |
| Wallet layer | browser | Reown AppKit (EVM, Solana) and WizardConnect (Bitcoin Cash) |
| `/api/relay` | server | pays Base gas for a gasless USDC deposit; nothing else |
| `/api/arrivals` | server | the keeper: keeps each swap contract's public terms, and a sweep every 10 minutes sends BCH left past the refund time back to its owner |
| Landing numbers | server | Cauldron's indexer, NEAR's prices and THORChain's halts, rebuilt at most once a minute |

## The stack

| Piece | Used for |
|---|---|
| Next.js 16, React 19 | the app, the landing page and the relayer route |
| Tailwind CSS 4, Base UI | the interface |
| TanStack Query 5 | quotes (fresh 10 s, refreshed 15 s, aborted when the request changes), prices, balances |
| viem, wagmi, Reown AppKit | EVM transfers, allowances, THORChain deposits, EIP-3009 signatures |
| @solana/web3.js, @solana/spl-token | Solana deposits |
| @wizardconnect/react, libauth | the Bitcoin Cash wallet, addresses and transactions |
| @electrum-cash/network | Bitcoin Cash coins, subscriptions and broadcasts |
| idb-keyval | swaps saved in the browser |

## Why the browser

Every provider Hashi uses answers browsers directly, so Hashi's server is never in the money path: quotes, deposits, trades and broadcasts go from your browser to NEAR Intents, THORChain, Cauldron, Electrum and your wallets. The server code is the gas relayer, the swap contracts' keeper (which can only send unfinished BCH back to its owner) and the landing page's numbers.
